zh: 规模非常小：披萨最多 10 种，配料最多 10 种且每种最多用一次、最多加两种，所以所有订单组合可以直接枚举。
一份订单 = 一种披萨 + 配料集合（0 种、1 种或两种不同下标的配料）。按“与预算差值的绝对值更小优先，差值相同取总价更低”来比较候选。
先列出所有配料额外价格：0、每种单独的价格、每两种不同下标配料之和；对每种披萨与每个额外价格求总价，若（|总价 − x|，总价）比当前最优更小就替换；初始最优可取第一种披萨不加配料；最后输出最优总价。
en: The sizes are tiny: at most 10 pizzas and at most 10 toppings, each topping used at most once and at most two of them, so every order can be enumerated directly.

An order is one pizza plus a topping set (none, one, or two toppings with different indices). Compare candidates by the smaller absolute difference from the budget first and, on a tie, the lower total price.

First list every topping extra: 0, each single topping's price, and the sum of every pair of toppings with different indices; for each pizza and each extra compute the total, and replace the best when (|total - x|, total) is smaller; start with the first pizza and no topping; print the best total.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate every pizza together with no topping, one topping, and two toppings with different indices. Compare candidates by (absolute difference, total price).

## Why it is correct

Every valid order contains exactly one pizza and a topping set of size at most 2; the enumeration covers these sets completely without using the same topping twice. The comparison rule takes the smallest difference first and then the lowest price, as the statement requires.

## Complexity

O(nm²+n) time, O(m²+1) extra space.
